jobs.occupation: Hotel Manager (m/w/d) – Lighthaus Hotel Cologne, A Tapestry Collection by Hilton Lifestyle Hotel  (General Manager/in (Hotellerie))
jobs.description: Open a landmark. Shape its character. Lead it from day one.A few minutes’ walk from Cologne Cathedral, a carefully restored listed building is about to become something new. Lighthaus Hotel Cologne will open in October 2027  as a 183-room lifestyle hotel within Hilton’s Tapestry Collection , and as the flagship of our group in Germany. Behind its historic façade you’ll find the beautifully restored Senatssaal, a restaurant, a bar and versatile event spaces.We’re looking for the Hotel Manager  who will take Lighthaus from plans and blueprints to a thriving, much-talked-about hotel. If you love building something from scratch, leading from the front and turning a strong concept into a real guest experience, we’d like to meet you. You'll start with us in February or March 2027 .What you’ll do• Lead the opening.  Steer the hotel through pre-opening and launch, working hand inhand with the project team.• Build your team . Recruit and develop the people who will bring Lighthaus to life, andset the culture, standards and style of service from the very start.• Run a great business.  Own day-to-day operations and the hotel’s financialperformance, with a sharp eye on sustainable revenue, labour costs and overallresults.• Put Lighthaus on the map . Build lasting relationships with local businesses, culturalinstitutions and the wider Cologne community.• Be the host . Set a warm, personal and distinctive tone across rooms, restaurant, barand events, and be a visible presence for guests and team alike.What you bring• Senior experience as a Hotel Manager, General Manager, Operations Manager or in acomparable hotel leadership role.• A track record of taking real ownership: budgets, forecasts, team and overall hotelperformance.• A commercial, entrepreneurial mindset and a hands-on approach to sales andbusiness development.• Sound judgement and a calm, organised and resilient way of working, especially underpressure.• Clear communication and fluent German and English.What we offer• The rare chance to shape a brand-new hotel from the very beginning and leave yourmark on its identity and success.• A distinctive Tapestry Collection by Hilton concept set in a landmark listed building withthe historic Senatssaal.• A flat organisational structure with short decision-making paths.• An annual bonus linked to hotel targets.• A contribution towards your Deutschlandticket.• Up to 30 days’ annual leave, depending on length of employment.ContactReady to open Lighthaus with us? We look forward to receiving your application.Do you have any questions? If so, please feel free to contact us at +49 (0) 30 – 5858383-81. You can submit your application, including your resume and relevant certificates, directly through our applicant portal.Contact: Birgit Ewald, Head of Human Resources
